verdict.rationale: The axis fairly applies: an online employer tax-services portal could offer recurring or scheduled filings and payments. However, nothing in the evidence shows user-configurable background automations. QuickFile and UTS cover one-off, user-initiated filing and payment, not recurring autonomous schedules. The probes also show no API or agent access, with the application host dropping keyless agent connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
